main_measure.name: OLS slope of forward 10-bar excess return (minus window mean 10-bar return) on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; inconclusive if < 40 samples or < 15 with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: share of positive 10-bar excess returns, forecast > 0 minus forecast = 0

decided_by: Inconclusive: the slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The holding drift is each window's mean forward 10-bar return over all its bars with a valid return, the excess returns are taken on the non-overlapping grid of positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window, the t is the OLS slope t (with intercept) on the pooled samples, and the supporting check passes when the positive share with forecast > 0 exceeds the share with forecast = 0.
